summary.text: Tony Kurtz is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 41 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Tony Kurtz served in the U.S. Army for two decades, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes owning a farm.
Kurtz was assigned to the Finance Committee and the Joint Finance Committee, serving as vice-chair of both, for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
